# photonic-konomi

> The two-surface machine, Stage 0: a photonic processor as exact mutation-gated arithmetic — hold superposition, compute by interference in one pass, collapse by seeded Born measurement. φ anti-crosstalk + κ coupling. For Thomas and the guild. MIT.

photonic-konomi is a sovereign, MIT-licensed build by Simon Gant (UK) — it runs in the browser, is free to own and fork, and is part of the AI Native Solutions estate. Source and a live page are linked below.
